tei:div.tei:p: bod yul bde ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// skyabs) gnas bslu med dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum// khyad par gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rje btsun sgrol ma gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs// smon lam yongs su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// snyigs dus 'gro rnams bsam sbyor log pa dang*// phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis// sngar ma grags pa'i mi phyugs dal yams nad// gza' klu rgyal gdon nag phyogs 'byung po'i zer// btsa' sad ser gsum lo nyes dmag 'khrugs rtsod// char chu mi snyoms gangs can bra bya'i than// sa g.yo me dgra 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa dang*// khyad par bstan la 'tshe ba'i mtha' dmag sogs// gangs can ljongs 'dir gnod 'tshe'i rigs mtha' dag /myur du zhi zhing rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /mi dang mi min 'gro ba mtha' dag gi /rgyud la byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ngang gis skyes nas gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor bral// phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan nas kyang*// bod yul mtha' dbus bde skyid dpal gyis 'byor// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shog /rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i stobs// 'khor 'das dge ba'i rtsa ba gang mchis dang*// bdag cag lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mthus// gsol btab smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub gyur cig /ces rje bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i zhal snga nas deng sang dus kyi 'tshub 'gyur shin tu che zhing ci ltar 'gyur nges pa med pas/ rje nyid nas bod yul bde ba'i smon lam nyin zhag rer lan drug re mdzad pa yin pas khyed nas kyang de ltar gal che zhes bka' bstsal phebs pa ltar/ rang gi bsnyel gsos su bris pa ji bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /ces blo gros mtha' yas kyis tsā 'dra rin chen brag tu rgyal zla ba'i dkar phyogs 'grub pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i snga dro'i cha la bris pa ya thā sid+dhi rastu//
